Hi Liam — thanks for the note and screenshot.

Short version: we can provision your supplier record with CAD, but procurement needs the following to proceed:
- Legal entity name (as registered)
- Business registration number / Tax ID (attach registration document)
- Bank details: bank name, branch transit number, account number, SWIFT/BIC (if international wires are required) — for CAD domestic payments a void cheque is sufficient
- Remit-to address and invoice submission email (if different from portal contact)
- Supplier contact for AP (name/phone/email)
- Certificate of insurance (if applicable)

If you prefer, we can accept bank details securely via the attached secure upload form and then manually add them into Ariba. Please do NOT send account numbers in plain email; use the secure form.

Next steps I will take on my side:
1) Check procurement system for any parent-entity currency locks (might be why the portal showed USD).
2) If that's the case, request an exception and create a manual supplier entry in Ariba on your behalf tied to CAD.

Please complete the secure_bank_upload_form.pdf and return it, or confirm you want us to proceed with manual provisioning and we'll provide a DocuSign link to capture consent.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Vendor Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

- Create a dedicated supplier record for GreenForge Manufacturing in Ariba with CAD as the primary currency.
- Populate the bank details using the secure form you submitted.
- Add ap@greenforge.com as the invoice submission email and the remit-to address as provided on the registration doc.

Required from you to finish provisioning:
1) Confirm the legal entity registration number exactly as you want it displayed on POs (reply to this thread).
2) Complete the DocuSign consent so we can store your banking info in the portal and remit payments. Link: https://www.docusign.com/secure/4Zxk-procurement-greenforge (expires in 7 days).

I will also attach the manual provisioning ticket to your HubSpot record and include the Ariba ticket ID so AP can reconcile when the first PO is issued.

If you prefer not to use Ariba for remittance, we can accept invoices directly and process via AP manually for the first 1–2 cycles; however, manual processing may delay payment cycles.
